purpose: Server-only Firestore/ArcGIS publication contract for approved immutable revisions.
workflowTransitions: PUBLISH_FAILED -> APPROVED (explicit operator requeue only after remediation)

submissionPublicationJob.concurrencyInvariant: A second delivery cannot claim a revision while an unexpired PUBLISHING lease exists. Expired leases are recoverable. Finalization/failure writes are fenced by active_lease_token.

sitePublicationLease.purpose: Serialize latest-site materialization updates for concurrent approved observations at the same site.
sitePublicationLease.concurrencyInvariant: Any different unexpired lease token blocks another publisher, even when the competing delivery references the same revision.

idempotency.arcgisKeyConstraint: Unique index on every dataset keyField

privacy.note: No Firestore Rules match is added for these server-only documents; Firebase Admin SDK is the only intended access path.
